name: Openverse
summary: Search openly licensed and public-domain images and audio (Creative Commons and similar) with license, creator and attribution for each work.
notes: Keyless: anonymous requests are rate limited; registered clients get slightly higher limits and larger pages. Exceeding a limit returns 429, and rate-limited responses carry headers with the remaining allowance.
Search is for the top results, not bulk download: only a few thousand results per query can be paged, and asking for a page beyond page_count is rejected. Anonymous callers also get smaller pages.
Use the attribution field of each result when reusing a work; licenses differ per item (by, by-sa, cc0, pdm, ...).
Parameters prefixed unstable__ are experimental and may change without notice.

endpoints.name: Search images
endpoints.summary: Openly licensed images matching a query or a creator, title or tag, filtered by license, source, category, size and aspect ratio.

creator.description: Search by creator only; ignored when q is present.

title.description: Search by title only; cannot be used with q. Fuzzy match.

tags.description: Search by tag only; cannot be used with q. Fuzzy match.

license.description: Comma-separated licenses: by, by-nc, by-nc-nd, by-nc-sa, by-nd, by-sa, cc0, nc-sampling+, pdm, sampling+.

license_type.description: Comma-separated license types: all, all-cc, commercial, modification.

mature.description: Include sensitive content; false by default.

filter_dead.description: Filter out results whose links return 404; true by default.

page_size.description: Results per page; 20 by default, capped lower for anonymous callers.

endpoints.name: Get an image
endpoints.summary: One image's URL, creator, license, license URL, provider, source, dimensions, tags and attribution text.

identifier.description: The image id (a UUID) from a search result.

endpoints.name: List related images
endpoints.summary: Images related to a given image.

endpoints.name: List image sources
endpoints.summary: Every image source with its source_name, display name, URL and number of images.

endpoints.name: Search audio
endpoints.summary: Openly licensed audio tracks matching a query or a creator, title or tag, filtered by license, source, category and length.

creator.description: Search by creator only; ignored when q is present.

title.description: Search by title only; cannot be used with q.

tags.description: Search by tag only; cannot be used with q.

license.description: Comma-separated licenses: by, by-nc, by-nc-nd, by-nc-sa, by-nd, by-sa, cc0, nc-sampling+, pdm, sampling+.

license_type.description: Comma-separated license types: all, all-cc, commercial, modification.

category.description: Comma-separated: audiobook, music, news, podcast, pronunciation, sound_effect.

mature.description: Include sensitive content; false by default.

endpoints.name: Get an audio track
endpoints.summary: One track's URL, creator, license, genres, duration, bit rate, sample rate, alternative files and attribution text.

identifier.description: The audio id (a UUID) from a search result.

endpoints.name: List audio sources
endpoints.summary: Every audio source with its source_name, display name, URL and number of tracks.
